scoring: every complete UTC pool-day whose 00:00 is after frozen_at; position opened at the first scored day's 00:00 with $5,000 of liquidity and held (setup cost charged once)

rule.hedge: Lighter PUMP (market 45) short = LP token units
rule.fee_model: GeckoTerminal 15m USD volume x 25 bp x L_ours/(L_pool+L_ours); pool liquidity from Deposit/WithdrawEvents

coverage_rule.rule: A missing GeckoTerminal 15-min pool bar = zero volume, price carried forward (justified by the on-chain check). A pool-day is scored if the Lighter PUMP 15-min candles have >= 90 of 96 bars and the pool has >= 1 GeckoTerminal bar that day. Days failing are listed and not scored (the position is still carried).

rule.margin_model: Short on Lighter at 1x: collateral = 1x short notional, reset to 1x of the current short notional at 00:00 UTC each day (capital moved between the LP wallet and Lighter; its transaction cost is inside the gas allowance). At every 15-min point, equity = collateral + hedge P&L since 00:00 - h x (Lighter candle HIGH of the coming bar - previous close). If equity < maintenance margin = 6% of h x high (Lighter orderBookDetails maintenance_margin_fraction 600, closeout 400, liquidation_fee 1.0 = 1%; data/raw/web/lphedge/lighter_orderbookdetails_PUMP.json), the short is liquidated: the whole remaining collateral is lost (conservative; covers the 1% fee), the LP is unhedged until the next 1h check, which re-opens the short at half spread. Collateral earns nothing.

costs.hedge_spread: half of the median measured $1k round trip: PUMP 1.877 bp per unit traded (76 snapshots, data/raw/web/memelead + data/raw/web/lphedge/lighter_spreads.jsonl)
costs.gas: 2 tx/day x 0.0005 SOL at the Lighter SOL close
costs.setup: once: buy and later sell the token half through the pool (30 bp + constant-product impact) and open/close the short at half spread; included in net, excluded from PF

bar.note: verdict only once n >= 50 scored pool-days; before that the ledger is 'accumulating'

caveats: Capital top-ups: in validation PUMP rose ~3.4x and the 1x short needed ~$4.6k of collateral top-ups financed by removing LP value; the frozen rule ignores the LP shrinkage. The ledger's 'with_topups' column models it (informational, not the bar).
Volume dependence: the edge is LP fee share minus LVR; it passed validation at volume/TVL ~0.30/day but the same rule made only +$52 (PF 1.17, fails) on train at ~0.12/day.
Fee model checked against exact on-chain fee growth only over 1.5 h (ratio 1.03).
Not modelled: hedge impact beyond $1k book depth, fee compounding, Lighter venue risk; funding sign convention inferred from Lighter docs.
